verified_facts.text: The hotel has been open since 1893.
The hotel was once home to Louisiana governor Huey P. Long.

verified_facts.text: The French Quarter is one block from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore the French Quarter one block from our doors.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a rooftop pool with city views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take in city views from our rooftop pool

verified_facts.text: The hotel's address is 130 Roosevelt Way, New Orleans, Louisiana 70112.

verified_facts.text: Check-in is at 4:00 PM and check-out is at 11:00 AM.
The hotel has a Waldorf Astoria Spa offering a variety of treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: Find yourself well-rested and refreshed at our hotel’s spa with a variety of treatments designed to relax the body and quiet the mind.

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms and suites are dressed in rich, warm decor with contemporary amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: each dressed in rich, warm décor with contemporary amenities

verified_facts.text: Fountain Lounge is one of the hotel's dining venues.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover authentic flavors presented by an expert culinary team at Fountain Lounge

verified_facts.text: The hotel hosts galas, events and weddings in flexible venues with catering.
verified_facts.excerpt: Host memorable galas and intimate events in flexible venues with access to catering and inspired menu options.

verified_facts.text: The lobby has gilded pillars, marble floors and large crystal chandeliers.
verified_facts.excerpt: The lobby is impressive, with gilded pillars, gleaming marble floors, and huge crystal chandeliers

verified_facts.text: The Sazerac Bar has retro murals, and the sazerac cocktail and Ramos gin fizz were both popularized there.
verified_facts.excerpt: ordering either a sazerac cocktail or a Ramos gin fizz (both drinks were popularized here) won’t disappoint

verified_facts.text: Domenica is the hotel's Italian dining room, with a happy hour.
verified_facts.excerpt: the attached Domenica dining room is one of the best Italian restaurants in town with a hard-to-beat happy hour

verified_facts.text: Teddy's Cafe is a casual coffee and pastry spot.
verified_facts.excerpt: Teddy’s Cafe is a casual coffee and pastry spot if you’re on the go.

verified_facts.text: Fountain Lounge has a menu of local dishes.
verified_facts.excerpt: The adjoining Fountain Lounge is less evocative but has a solid menu of local dishes

verified_facts.text: Rooms have dark mahogany furniture and antique fixtures.
verified_facts.excerpt: It oozed regal charm with its dark mahogany furniture and antique fixtures.

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler places the hotel at the more expensive end of New Orleans accommodations.
